title: Re-measure dollars per PR after the 11-09 cuts on 30 merged PRs
body:
Outcome: lead and subagent $/PR after #513 are re-measured on at least 30 merged PRs with `scripts/claude/spend-window.py`, and the roadmap is reranked from the result.
Why: t-5xvjxp7 (460c9b4) measured lead $2.39 -> $0.42 and subagent $2.03 -> $0.27 per PR, but on only 12 PRs after #513; the same-day slice (lead $0.84, subagent $0.32 over 50 PRs) shows the 12-PR window may flatter the cuts.
Proof: the task body records both windows with sample sizes; the roadmap PR cites them.
Scope: scripts/claude/spend-window.py, docs/program/roadmap.md.
